fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-03-17 at roughly 05:45, it was reported that a grey auto bearing registration number TN-45-ZZ-1074 used by the complainant for daily work was taken from Vaigai Park Parking Area in Chennai. Uma Raj approached Chennai South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000089. A further person, Hariharan Babu, a co-worker, using the number 9000000154, is stated to be associated with the incident. Hariharan Raj (mobile 9000000328) was named as a possible person of interest. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Vehicle allegedly driven away after being left unattended.
fields.Keywords: auto theft, vehicle, photograph, associate, early morning, auto, suspect, CCTV
